title: Lounge TV says no internet
symptom: The smart TV in the lounge cannot play videos and says no internet connection
user_description: The TV in the lounge says no internet connection. People want to watch the company video at lunch. Can I just give it the staff Wi-Fi password?

options.text: Give the TV the staff Wi-Fi password
options.why: The staff network is for staff laptops and phones. Smart devices like TVs usually go on a separate network so they cannot reach staff computers and files.
This wipes all its settings and apps and does not fix the network problem.
The TV works. It has only lost its network connection.

options.text: Check the TV's network settings and reconnect it to the network meant for office devices or guests, not the staff network
options.why: The TV dropped off its network. Reconnecting it to the devices or guest network fixes it and keeps it apart from staff computers.

hints: Is the TV on a cable or Wi-Fi?
What do the TV's network settings show?
Which network should smart devices use?
real_world_tip: Many offices put TVs, printers and other smart devices on their own network, separate from staff computers. Check which network your office uses for devices.
